teaser: Three logs left on the fire, and you get up to find a fourth before anyone else notices the flame dipping. Life path 4 is the Builder, and you're an ESFP, wired for the present moment more than the plan. Most people lean on one of those at a time. You carry both: a number that wants the structure finished and letters that want the night exactly as it is, unscheduled and warm. The pull between them shows up in small places — who keeps the fire fed, and who never quite pitches the tent before dark.
excerpt: Eleven at night, chairs already stacking on the tables around the booth, the two of you still finishing a conversation the day never had room for.
